title: servers.word_filter_updated
description: WordFilterUpdated is published every time a server's banned words list changes. It carries the whole list, not a diff, so consumers keep the one with the newest occurred_at and a repeated or late event never undoes a newer change. Words must never be nil: an empty list (no filter) has to marshal as [] and not as null.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

words.description: Palabras o frases prohibidas, normalizadas (minúsculas, sin espacios de más). Lista vacía = sin filtro.
